fusions.name: Weaving Snare
fusions.desc: Spins silk around every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 9 damage and leaving each with a 70% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Wrapped Bite
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A strike that deals 9 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Silk Pylon
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to spin a web anchor beside you for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it strikes enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage.

fusions.name: Fed Lines
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
